name: 行级锁与 Advisory Lock 诊断
description: PostgreSQL 行级锁（SELECT FOR UPDATE/SHARE/NO KEY UPDATE/KEY SHARE）和 Advisory Lock（应用层分布式锁）是并发控制的核心工具。行级锁使用不当导致死锁或长时间等待，Advisory Lock 忘记释放导致资源泄漏。SKIP LOCKED 和 NOWAIT 是高并发场景的关键优化手段。

signals.desc: pg_stat_activity 中 wait_event_type = 'Lock' 的会话数量异常增多
pg_locks 中 locktype = 'advisory' 的锁数量持续增长不释放
日志出现 ERROR: deadlock detected

conditions.desc: 超过 5 个会话在等待行级锁

skip_when.desc: 无锁等待且无死锁发生

root_causes.name: SELECT FOR UPDATE 范围过大
root_causes.desc: 查询锁定了过多行（如忘记加 WHERE 条件或锁定了整个结果集），导致其他事务长时间等待。常见于批量处理任务锁定大量行。

root_causes.name: 死锁：多表/多行交叉锁定顺序不一致
root_causes.desc: 两个事务以不同顺序锁定同一组行或表，形成循环等待。PostgreSQL 会检测并终止其中一个事务（deadlock_timeout 默认 1s）。

root_causes.name: Advisory Lock 泄漏
root_causes.desc: pg_advisory_lock() 获取后事务异常退出未调用 pg_advisory_unlock()。Session-level advisory lock 需显式释放或等会话断开，Transaction-level advisory lock 事务结束自动释放。

root_causes.name: 缺少 SKIP LOCKED 或 NOWAIT 优化
root_causes.desc: 高并发任务队列场景使用普通 FOR UPDATE 导致串行化。SKIP LOCKED 可跳过已被锁定的行实现并行消费，NOWAIT 可立即报错避免等待。

step1_lock_waiters.desc: 查看当前锁等待链：谁在等谁
step1_lock_waiters.sql: SELECT blocked.pid AS blocked_pid, blocked.usename AS blocked_user, blocking.pid AS blocking_pid, blocking.usename AS blocking_user, blocked.query AS blocked_query, blocking.query AS blocking_query, blocked.wait_event_type, blocked.wait_event, now() - blocked.query_start AS blocked_duration FROM pg_stat_activity blocked JOIN pg_locks bl ON blocked.pid = bl.pid AND NOT bl.granted JOIN pg_locks gl ON bl.locktype = gl.locktype AND bl.database IS NOT DISTINCT FROM gl.database AND bl.relation IS NOT DISTINCT FROM gl.relation AND bl.page IS NOT DISTINCT FROM gl.page AND bl.tuple IS NOT DISTINCT FROM gl.tuple AND bl.transactionid IS NOT DISTINCT FROM gl.transactionid AND bl.classid IS NOT DISTINCT FROM gl.classid AND bl.objid IS NOT DISTINCT FROM gl.objid AND bl.objsubid IS NOT DISTINCT FROM gl.objsubid AND gl.granted JOIN pg_stat_activity blocking ON gl.pid = blocking.pid WHERE blocked.pid <> blocking.pid ORDER BY blocked_duration DESC

step2_deadlock_stats.sql: SELECT datname, deadlocks, conflicts, temp_files, temp_bytes FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname = current_database()

step3_advisory_locks.desc: 查看当前持有的 Advisory Lock
step3_advisory_locks.sql: SELECT l.pid, a.usename, a.application_name, l.classid, l.objid, l.mode, l.granted, a.state, now() - a.xact_start AS lock_duration FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON l.pid = a.pid WHERE l.locktype = 'advisory' ORDER BY lock_duration DESC NULLS LAST

step4_row_lock_details.desc: 查看行级锁的详细信息
step4_row_lock_details.sql: SELECT l.pid, l.locktype, l.relation::regclass AS table_name, l.mode, l.granted, a.state, a.wait_event_type, a.wait_event, LEFT(a.query, 120) AS query FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON l.pid = a.pid WHERE l.locktype IN ('relation', 'tuple', 'transactionid') AND l.relation IS NOT NULL ORDER BY l.granted, l.relation

step5_lock_mode_conflicts.desc: 查看锁模式冲突矩阵中的实际冲突
step5_lock_mode_conflicts.sql: SELECT wait.pid AS waiter, wait.mode AS wait_mode, hold.pid AS holder, hold.mode AS hold_mode, wait.relation::regclass AS table_name FROM pg_locks wait JOIN pg_locks hold ON wait.relation = hold.relation AND wait.pid <> hold.pid WHERE NOT wait.granted AND hold.granted ORDER BY wait.relation

version_specific_notes.12: pg_locks 支持查看所有锁类型。deadlock_timeout 默认 1s
version_specific_notes.13: 改进行级锁在 partitioned table 上的行为，子表锁继承更合理
version_specific_notes.14: IDLE IN TRANSACTION 自动终止（idle_in_transaction_session_timeout）对锁泄漏防护增强
version_specific_notes.15: pg_stat_activity 新增 query_id 字段，便于关联锁等待和具体查询
version_specific_notes.16: Advisory Lock 性能改进。pg_locks 显示更详细的 waitstart 时间戳
version_specific_notes.17: 改进 tuple-level lock 的内存管理，减少高并发锁竞争时的内存开销

real_world_examples.scenario: 任务队列表高并发消费导致大量锁等待
real_world_examples.symptoms: 50 个 worker 同时 SELECT FOR UPDATE 抢任务，平均等待 3s，吞吐量只有 20 TPS
real_world_examples.root_cause: 所有 worker 竞争同一行（ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE），串行化执行
real_world_examples.resolution: 改用 SKIP LOCKED，每个 worker 跳过已被锁定的行直接取下一条
real_world_examples.result: 吞吐量从 20 TPS 提升到 800 TPS，锁等待降为 0

real_world_examples.scenario: 分布式锁用 session-level advisory lock 导致锁泄漏
real_world_examples.symptoms: pg_locks 中 advisory 锁数量持续增长到 5000+，新请求获取锁超时
real_world_examples.root_cause: 应用用 pg_advisory_lock(hash) 但异常退出时未调用 unlock，连接池复用连接后锁未释放
real_world_examples.resolution: 改用 pg_advisory_xact_lock() 事务级锁，事务结束自动释放
real_world_examples.result: Advisory Lock 泄漏问题彻底解决
